description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants associated with various criteria. The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled "Criterion," with the bars ordered from top to bottom. The horizontal axis represents the values, labeled "Number of Participants," featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 6 with tick marks and vertical grid lines at intervals of 2. The bars are sorted in descending order based on their length and transition in color from dark purple at the top to yellow-green at the bottom. The tallest bar, labeled "Relevant FCs," is dark purple and has an annotated value of 6. This is followed by "FC Summary" in dark blue with a value of 5, "Relevance Explanation" in dark teal with a value of 3, and "Clarity and Simplicity" in medium teal, also with a value of 3. The "Overall Summary" bar is green and extends to a value of 2; unlike the others, it lacks a bold numeric annotation but features a small grey square immediately to its right. The shortest bars are located at the bottom: "Filters" in light green and "Veracity Explanation" in yellow-green, both with an annotated value of 1. Most bars are visually emphasized with their exact numeric values printed in bold black text to the right of the bar ends.
